Game Overview

In Merge For Renovation, the core idea is straightforward: unleash creativity as you transform your home in Merge For Renovation. Merge identical items to craft new essentials for endless renovation tasks. Earn stars to upgrade and customize your dream house in this addictive journey, where strategic planning and rewarding progression fuel your imaginative escape.
